name: Agents
description: Covers the processes and rules around agents acting on behalf of students, including court-appointed agents, Power of Attorney, Enduring Power of Attorney, appointing agents without informed consent, and how organisations or companies act as agents.

attributes.summary: Guidance on agent arrangements for student support, including court orders, power of attorney, organisational agents, telephone contact, and discretion not to deal with an agent.
steps: Agent appointed by a Court Order
Appointing an agent without the student's informed consent
When an organisation or company acts as an agent
Discretion not to deal with an agent
